source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "digital platforms" AND (power OR governance OR capitalism OR regulation OR monopoly)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"digital platforms" AND (power OR governance OR capitalism OR regulation OR monopoly),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("digital platforms" AND ("capitalism" OR "governance" OR "monopoly" OR "power" OR "regulation"))
